query: What signals are linked to longer resolution duration values?

per_column.name: incident_type
per_column.rationale: Type of incident (database, email, VPN) is a legitimate predictor of resolution time, known at intake and outside the focus variable.

per_column.name: infrastructure_target
per_column.rationale: The affected system/component plausibly influences how long resolution takes; independent of duration and knowable early.

per_column.name: assigned_technician
per_column.rationale: Individual technician can correlate with speed of resolution; a valid feature, though partly determined after assignment it is not a restatement of duration.

per_column.name: technician_handoff
per_column.rationale: Whether the ticket was handed off between technicians is typically only known over the course of the incident and is a consequence of prolonged handling, correlating mechanically with longer duration rather than being an independent antecedent predictor.

per_column.name: caller_type
per_column.rationale: Caller type (named vs ITIL user) is an intake attribute outside the focus and may carry weak-to-moderate predictive signal.

per_column.name: issue_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope (single user vs building-wide vs infrastructure) plausibly predicts effort/duration and is knowable at intake, independent of the outcome.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: A boolean severity indicator is an antecedent characteristic that can influence resolution time; not a restatement of duration.

per_column.name: issue_complexity_signal
per_column.rationale: A generic 'complexity' label is likely inferred from or proxies the effort/time itself, making it a near-restatement of the outcome rather than an independent predictor; borderline leakage.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate antecedent predictors of resolution duration (incident type, infrastructure target, technician, caller type, scope, severity) that lie outside the focus and plausibly carry signal. However, technician_handoff is largely a consequence of a prolonged incident (leakage), and issue_complexity_signal reads as a proxy/restatement of the very effort that determines duration. The predictor set overlaps somewhat with existing columns (priority, category, assignment_group) and several fields are correlated with one another, limiting the marginal leverage. Net: a moderately useful but partly redundant/contaminated feature set.
